separate_findings.title: Trailing slash in a node URI
separate_findings.observation: The supplied example on native N3 treats its own URI with a trailing slash as a remote node and reports a transport-lineage permission error. Removing the slash completes it on N3.

separate_findings.title: Copied writeln from Trealla to SWI
separate_findings.observation: On public N5, the added writeln(Self) is exported as the Trealla-specific actors:terminal_output(...,[source(io)]) rewrite and rejected by native N3. Replacing it with format('~w~n',[Self]) and using the node URI without a trailing slash completes all three rounds on public N5. format/1 itself is supported.
